target.paper: Permanental Inequalities and Unit Interval Orders

author_implementation.use: Independent C implementation of the public mathematical operations; no substantial MATLAB code copied. Author notice retained for attribution.

bruhat_criterion.inequality: For every r,c, count(i<=r with w_i<=c) >= count(i<=r with f_n(w)_i<=c).

implementation_map.meaning: Source domain A_n preserves floor(n/2) initial labels and complementary final labels; the tilde domain uses ceil(n/2). Target B_n preserves position/value parity.

source_clarifications: The complementary block split is ceil(n/2); its labels begin at ceil(n/2)+1. Use the type-correct complementary-domain map.
Maximum insertion permits the final append position n+1 when extending a permutation of size n.

The thesis p.60 displayed obstruction determines insertion slots 6 and 5, whereas its printed indices say 5 and 4. The source controls use the displayed permutations and verify both the failed comparison and that the example is not the special recursive f6 pair.
The explicit f6 worked example is used instead of duplicating misprinted table entries.
The northwest rank direction is checked in both directions against a published comparable pair.
literature_scope: The named paper and thesis report n<=13. The n=14 check here is not a claim of worldwide novelty or an exhaustive later-literature audit.
